note: Clause 1 forbidden: an ACK Identifier that is not the previous Request plus one; TestRFC5216ServerAckIdentifiersIncrementAndTheNextFragmentEchoesThem errors on ack.Identifier != serverSent[i].Identifier+1. Clause 2 forbidden: the peer fragment after an ACK carries another Identifier; the same test errors on next.Identifier != ack.Identifier, and driveFragmentedFlight fatals if the authenticator accepts a fragment re-numbered with a stale Identifier.
